_note: New actor, first pricing entry. PAY_PER_EVENT, tiered from day one: a notice affecting 100+ workers, or a full closure, is the one recruiters, outplacement firms and investors act on, so it carries the premium. No per-run free allowance (a poller). Runs with no new notices return nothing and cost nothing. Seven official sources, no proxy.

warn_notice.eventDescription: One WARN layoff or closure notice from a state labor agency, with company, state, city or county, workers affected, notice and layoff dates, and type where the state publishes it. A run with no new notices is free.

major_warn_notice.eventDescription: One WARN notice affecting 100 or more workers, or a full closure, with the same fields and the reasons it was flagged. A notice is charged once, under one event only.
